eyebrow: SQL Server Performance Tuning · Chapter Seven
subtitle: Lesson 33 · Query Store & Automatic Tuning

steps.label: Plan store
steps.sub: distinct, deduplicated execution plans per query

steps.label: Runtime stats store
steps.sub: aggregated duration, CPU, reads — bucketed by interval

steps.label: Both persist
steps.sub: in the user database, surviving recompiles and restarts

code:
ALTER DATABASE CURRENT SET QUERY_STORE = ON
(
  OPERATION_MODE = READ_WRITE,
  CLEANUP_POLICY =
    (STALE_QUERY_THRESHOLD_DAYS = 30),
  MAX_STORAGE_SIZE_MB = 1000,
  INTERVAL_LENGTH_MINUTES = 60,
  QUERY_CAPTURE_MODE = AUTO
);
caption: Every option is a tuning decision, not a default to accept.

code:
SELECT TOP 20
  qt.query_sql_text, q.query_id, p.plan_id,
  rs.avg_duration, rs.count_executions
FROM sys.query_store_query q
JOIN sys.query_store_query_text qt
  ON q.query_text_id = qt.query_text_id
JOIN sys.query_store_plan p
  ON q.query_id = p.query_id
JOIN sys.query_store_runtime_stats rs
  ON p.plan_id = rs.plan_id
ORDER BY rs.avg_duration DESC;
caption: Four catalog views power every Query Store report.
